create_direct_optimizer: create a direct_lib.Direct optimizer with a mujoco model and configuration length
build_particle_rollout: build a particle simulation rollout caching position, velocity, acceleration, control, force, and sensor data
test_optimizer_data: test the optimizer.data method to set configuration, sensor measurement, force measurement, and time per timestep
run_optimizer_smoother: run the optimizer with noise settings, sensor and force flags, and convergence tolerances to optimize trajectory
summarize_optimizer_solution: summarize the optimizer solution by retrieving estimated configuration, velocity, sensor prediction, and time arrays
